items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I play with the Chamelea band too. Whose band was that? That's Janet Ferdahls and George Stewart, the clarinet player.

ctx.x: I can't play, Sam. I guess I've heard of him.

Yeah. I'll forget his name. Lucian used to play with him. My brother Lucian played with him too. And I'll say, I play with the Chamelea band too. Whose band was that? That's Janet Ferdahls and George Stewart, the clarinet player. George Stewart, yeah. George Stewart, yeah.
You don't hear too much about him. Whatever happened to him? He died. He's one of the old ones, yeah. He was an elderly fellow?

items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I can recall the old man who was a bass player. the bass player, Johnny Prodoss and George Stude.

ctx.x: He was a fine clarinet player though. He was a steward.

I don't know the trumpet players or something like that. I can recall the old man who was a bass player. the bass player, Johnny Prodoss and George Stude. And Albert Walters said he played with them, trumpet player Albert Fernandez and he'll play with us now. He said he worked with them.
Do you remember Wooden Joe Nicholas? Oh yeah, I remember Wooden Joe. Did he play with the Camellia Band?
